---
title: "Versions and releases"
description: >
  kitDesign's versioning rules, release steps, and how apps upgrade.
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
```

> This page is `brand/en/release.md` in kitDesign (the English translation of `brand/版本與發布.md`). For what changed in each version, see the [changelog](../news/index.html).

```{r, results = "asis"}
md <- readLines(file.path("..", "..", "brand", "en", "release.md"), encoding = "UTF-8")
md <- md[-1]
md <- md[!grepl("^English \\| \\[", md)]  # the language switch line: the site uses the navbar
md <- gsub("](design-language.md)", "](design-language.html)", md, fixed = TRUE)
md <- gsub("](migration.md)",
           "](https://github.com/jiewenTsai/kitDesign/blob/main/brand/en/migration.md)", md, fixed = TRUE)
cat(md, sep = "\n")
```
